en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Al Hakam, from Musna Al Hannat, from Abu Baseer who said,

‘I went over to Abu Ja’far<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup>, so I said to him<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup>, ‘You (Imams<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup>) are the inheritors of the Prophets<sup style="font-weight: normal">saww</sup>?’ He<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> said: ‘Yes’. I said, ‘Rasool-Allah<sup style="font-weight: normal">saww</sup> is an inheritor of the Prophets<sup style="font-weight: normal">as</sup>, knowing everything what they<sup style="font-weight: normal">as</sup> were knowing?’ He<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> said to me: ‘Yes’. I said, ‘So you (Imams<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup>) are able upon reviving the death, and curing the blind and the leper?’ He<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> said: ‘Yes, by the Permission of Allah<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup>’.

Then he<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> said to me: ‘Approach me<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup>, O Abu Muhammad!’ So I approached him<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup>, and he<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> wiped his<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> hand upon my face and upon my eyes. So I visualised the sun, and the sky, and the earth, and the houses, and everything in the city. Then he<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> said to me: ‘Would you love it to become like this, and for you would be what is for the people, and upon you would be what would be upon them on the Day of Judgment, or to return to just as you were, and for you would be the Paradise purely?’ I said, ‘To return to just as I was’. So he<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> wiped upon my eyes, so I returned to just as I was’.
He (Abu Baseer) said, ‘So I narrated to Ibn Abu Umeyr with this, so he said, ‘I testify that this is true just as the day is true’.
